At.description:
Where to anchor something in the code. The most robust option for an agent is `find`:
the exact text to search for (optionally narrowed to `line` and to the `occurrence`-th match).

col.description: Grapheme offset within the line (0-based). Rarely needed; prefer `find`.

find.description: Exact text to search for in the code (e.g. "takes(s)"). With `line`, that line is searched first.

line.description: Absolute line number (1-based), as shown in the TUI. Optional when using `find`.

occurrence.description: Which match of `find` to use (1-based). Defaults to the first.

color.description: Color: orange, blue, green, purple, pink, cyan, yellow, red, gray or #rrggbb. Arrows without a color rotate through the palette.

head_end.description: Head at the target: arrow (default), none, dot, bar, open. none+none draws a plain connector.

head_start.description: Head at the source: none (default), arrow, dot, bar, open

label.description: Text next to the arrow head (e.g. "move")

stroke.description: Line stroke: solid (default), dashed, dotted, thick, double

border.description: Border stroke: solid (default), dashed, dotted, thick, double

color.description: Color: orange, blue, green, purple, pink, cyan, yellow, red, gray or #rrggbb. Arrows without a color rotate through the palette.

fill.description: Tint the inside: true/false (boxes default to true, callouts to false)

find_end.description: Text on the last line of the box, searched after find_start (same line allowed). Fails with text_not_found naming the marker.

find_start.description: Text on the first line of the box (e.g. a comment marker `// begin` or code like `fn takes`), instead of from_line. Must be given with find_end.

from_line.description: First line enclosed by the box (1-based). Or give find_start/find_end instead.

id.description: Custom id (e.g. "box-takes"); if omitted, a1, a2… is assigned

label.description: Label drawn on the top edge

step.description: Presentation step at which it appears (1-based). Defaults to the current step.

to_line.description: Last line enclosed by the box (inclusive); defaults to from_line

border.description: Border stroke: solid (default), dashed, dotted, thick, double

fill.description: Tint the inside: true/false (boxes default to true, callouts to false)

find_end.description: Text on the last line of the range, searched after find_start

find_start.description: Text on the first line of the range, instead of from_line (with find_end)

placement.description: margin (default: right margin, aligned with from_line), below (own rows under to_line; drawn inside a box only when the box contains the whole range, otherwise after its bottom border) or auto

text.description: Body: two or three sentences, wrapped by words. Newlines start new paragraphs.

title.description: Short title embedded in the top border

to_line.description: Last line it explains; defaults to from_line

width.description: Max text width in columns (default ~34 in the margin, full code width below)

At.description:
Where to anchor something in the code. The most robust option for an agent is `find`:
the exact text to search for (optionally narrowed to `line` and to the `occurrence`-th match).

col.description: Grapheme offset within the line (0-based). Rarely needed; prefer `find`.

find.description: Exact text to search for in the code (e.g. "takes(s)"). With `line`, that line is searched first.

line.description: Absolute line number (1-based), as shown in the TUI. Optional when using `find`.

occurrence.description: Which match of `find` to use (1-based). Defaults to the first.

glyph.description: Glyph, one or two cells wide (box-drawing, arrows, emoji)

legend.description: Short legend shown after the glyph

color.description: Color: orange, blue, green, purple, pink, cyan, yellow, red, gray or #rrggbb. Arrows without a color rotate through the palette.

emphasis.description: How the span is drawn: fill (background tint, default), underline (▔ row under it), brackets (⌈ ⌉ beside it), strike (struck through)

kind.description: Built-in kind (info, note, warn, error, ok, question, important, read, write, move, new, drop, scope, flow, todo; aliases like borrow/borrow_mut/lifetime work), a style defined with define_style, or any name when `style` carries a glyph.

label.description: Extra text after the legend (e.g. "s goes into t")

style.description: Inline one-off style for this mark: {glyph, legend, color}. Overrides the kind's fields.

action.description: `code.patch` (default: edit lines of the file shown at the step), `code.link` (show another file — or the main file again — from this step on; each file keeps its own annotations), `cursor`, `select` or `wait`

after.description: insert: text of the line the content goes after (must match exactly one line)

at_step.description: Step at which the code changes (>= 1). Going back to an earlier step reverts it.

before.description: insert: text of the line the content goes before (must match exactly one line)

content.description: insert/replace: the new lines, separated by newlines

file.description: code.link: the file to show, relative to the .tiza directory (as `code.file` names it); naming the main file links back to it

find.description: replace/delete: text of the one line to change (must match exactly one line)

find_end.description: replace/delete: text on the last line of the range (with find_start)

find_start.description: replace/delete: text on the first line of the range (with find_end)

from.description: select: where the selection starts — `{find}` (exactly one match at that step, or with `occurrence`) or `{line, col}`

line.description: cursor: the line (real file line number) of the shown file

lines.description: code.link: a window `A-B` (or `A`) of the file to show; only a crop, annotations keep real file line numbers and a note outside the window is kept but not drawn

ms.description: wait: milliseconds to pause before the step's annotations appear (TUI, GIF and tape; a still render ignores it)

occurrence.description: Which match of find/after/before/find_start to use when the text appears more than once: 1-based, counted in reading order over the whole code as it is at that step. Without it, more than one match is an error

position.description: insert: the line the content goes before (last+1 appends). replace/delete: a line or range `A-B`, as shown at that step

rebind.description: Where annotations the patch replaces or deletes go afterwards, by id: `{"a3": {"at": {"find": "text", "occurrence": 2}}}`, `{"a4": {"from_line": 7, "to_line": 9}}` (same fields as update_annotation's move), resolved on the code after the patch; a find must match exactly once there or carry occurrence. Needed for column anchors (highlights, marks, arrow ends) on a replaced line: those go (unanchored) otherwise

speed_ms.description: Milliseconds per line (`line`, default 120) or per character (`char`, default 25)

to.description: select: where it ends — `{find}` (the end of the found text) or `{line, col}`

typing.description: `instant` (default), `line` or `char`: how the content appears when the presenter reaches the step

color.description: Color: orange, blue, green, purple, pink, cyan, yellow, red, gray or #rrggbb. Arrows without a color rotate through the palette.

line.description: Line the note is anchored to

text.description: Note text (a short sentence: goes in the right margin or below the line)

find_end.description: Text on the last line of the range, searched after find_start

find_start.description: Text on the first line of the range, instead of from_line (with find_end)

from_line.description: First line to highlight (the rest of the code is dimmed)

ids.description: Ids of annotations to highlight; the others are dimmed and their code stays in focus

step.description: Step at which it activates (defaults to the current one)

to_line.description: Last line to highlight; defaults to from_line

until.description: Last step at which it stays active; defaults to `step` only

width.description: Width in columns to check the labels at; defaults to 100, as `tiza render`

step.description: If given, removes only the annotations of that step; otherwise all of them

interval.description: GIF and animated WebP: seconds each step stays on screen, 0 to 3600 (default 2; the last one twice as long)

path.description: Where to write the file. The extension picks the format: .png, .svg, .txt, .ansi, .md, .gif (an animated GIF of every step, drawn by Tiza itself), or .webp (lossless: with `step`, one step, as a .png; without it, every step, as a .gif)

skip_zero.description: GIF and animated WebP: start at step 1 instead of step 0, the bare code (default false)

step.description: Step to show; defaults to the current one. Past the last step, the last is exported and the reply says so in `warning`

theme.description: dark or light; defaults to the document's theme

width.description: Width in columns; defaults to the live terminal's width

id.description: The `id` of a named step (the document's `steps` list), or a step number: `4` or `"4"` (a number always means a step number).

At.description:
Where to anchor something in the code. The most robust option for an agent is `find`:
the exact text to search for (optionally narrowed to `line` and to the `occurrence`-th match).

col.description: Grapheme offset within the line (0-based). Rarely needed; prefer `find`.

find.description: Exact text to search for in the code (e.g. "takes(s)"). With `line`, that line is searched first.

line.description: Absolute line number (1-based), as shown in the TUI. Optional when using `find`.

occurrence.description: Which match of `find` to use (1-based). Defaults to the first.

color.description: Color: orange, blue, green, purple, pink, cyan, yellow, red, gray or #rrggbb. Arrows without a color rotate through the palette.

emphasis.description: How the span is drawn: fill (background tint, default), underline (▔ row under it), brackets (⌈ ⌉ beside it), strike (struck through)

find.description: Text that names the line: on `line` when given, else it must appear exactly once in the code shown

from.description: First line of a range to point at (instead of `line`)

line.description: The line to point at (with `find`: the line the text is on)

to.description: Last line of the range (defaults to `from`)

width.description: Width in columns of the take. Without it, the width of the screen's code area (the terminal minus its padding), as `visible` judges it.

from_line.description: First focused line; omit both to clear the focus

enabled.description: true to reload the code whenever the source file is saved (annotations are re-anchored to their text), false to stop

step.description: Step to show (1-based). Clamped to the valid range.

theme.description: dark, light, terminal (the host's palette), auto (follow the terminal) or toggle

At.description:
Where to anchor something in the code. The most robust option for an agent is `find`:
the exact text to search for (optionally narrowed to `line` and to the `occurrence`-th match).

col.description: Grapheme offset within the line (0-based). Rarely needed; prefer `find`.

find.description: Exact text to search for in the code (e.g. "takes(s)"). With `line`, that line is searched first.

line.description: Absolute line number (1-based), as shown in the TUI. Optional when using `find`.

occurrence.description: Which match of `find` to use (1-based). Defaults to the first.

at.description: Move a highlight, mark or note to another position (same `find`/line/col as add_mark). Kind, style and label are kept.

border.description: Boxes/callouts: border stroke (solid, dashed, dotted, thick, double)

color.description: New color (palette name or #rrggbb); an empty string returns to automatic

emphasis.description: Highlights/marks: how the span is drawn (fill, underline, brackets, strike)

file.description: The file the annotation goes to, as a `code.link` names it. `null` is the main file. Leave it out to keep the file of the annotation.

from_line.description: Boxes, callouts, spotlights and notes: new first line

head_end.description: Arrows: head at the target (none, arrow, dot, bar, open)

head_start.description: Arrows: head at the source (none, arrow, dot, bar, open)

label.description: New label: the text of a note, the title of a callout. An empty string removes a label or a title. A note keeps its text.

step.description: New step at which it appears

stroke.description: Arrows: new stroke (solid, dashed, dotted, thick, double)

to_line.description: Boxes, callouts and spotlights: new last line
